name: maintenant Community
free_limit: Self-hosted Community edition: 1 host, 10 endpoints, 5 heartbeats, 5 certificate monitors, 7 days of resource history, 3 status-page components; Discord and webhook alerts. Free indefinitely.
watch_out: Community edition limits apply; email/Telegram alerts, remote hosts and extended retention require paid editions. Hosting, storage and operations are not included. Apache-2.0 covers the core; paid-feature source files have a separate commercial license. No built-in authentication; protect the dashboard behind an authenticated reverse proxy. Anonymous telemetry is opt-out.
